about: Succession model data (packages/core/src/succession.ts), written by `pnpm knowledge:succession` (scripts/build_succession.ts): transition counts between adjacent dance tandas of public DJ sets, each [raw count, weighted count] (reference sets weigh 1, the cached set-blog sets 0.5), plus the hand-curated parts from succession_curated.json. Do not edit by hand.

curated.about: Hand-curated inputs of the succession model (packages/core/src/succession.ts): which tanda follows which well. `pnpm knowledge:succession` (scripts/build_succession.ts) copies this file into data/knowledge/succession.json beside the transition counts it mines from the DJ sets. Voice classes are estimates from the recordings (a timbre class, not a range test): high-tenor = light, bright, high-placed voices; tenor = the middle lyric voices; baritone = dark, low voices; female. A singer missing here is simply not compared. Lineages are sound families: orchestras whose leader or arrangers came out of another's band and kept its sound, so back to back they read as the same orchestra again.

points.about: the parts of the score, in points (positive = follows well); score = tanh(sum / scale)

styleMatrix.about: tango → tango, row = the tanda before, column = the next one; classes as transitions.ts styleClass (R+ hard-driving rhythmic, R rhythmic, L lyrical, B balanced, D dramatic). Alternation is rewarded (D'Arienzo → Di Sarli), two rhythmic in a row tire the floor, two dramatic never.

lineages.about: sound families (the leader's band and the bands that kept its sound)
